results.title: sqlite-vec: vector search in SQLite
results.description: A tiny, dependency-free vector search extension for SQLite that runs anywhere SQLite runs.
results.notes: Use this for the rebalance semantic index. KNN via the MATCH operator on a vec0 virtual table.

results.title: linkding — self-hosted bookmark manager
results.description: Minimal, fast bookmark service you can self-host. Has a token-authenticated REST API.
results.notes: Candidate first external plugin for rebalance-OS. /api/bookmarks/ is paginated.
